note: Privately run hot springs resort at 860 Tecopa Hot Springs Road on the southeast approach to Death Valley, with back-in full-hookup RV sites, open ground for dry camping (check in with the camp host), a motel and cabins, and a bathhouse with two private 104°F mineral soaking tubs. Separate from the county's Tecopa Hot Springs Campground just north. --Claude

flags: WEBSITE: https://www.tecopahotsprings.org/ -> https://www.amystecopahotspringsresort.com/ . The old domain now serves a Danish online-casino spam page ('CASINO UDEN ROFUS'); the old site's last real captures (Wayback 20250618235841, 20260207203148) point to amystecopahotspringsresort.com.
PHONE: 442-453-1987 -> (760) 852-4420 (resort site, ResNexus header, Google Maps all agree; 442-453-1987 appears on none of them).

PRIVATE PARK: Google Maps 4.2 stars, 321 reviews (passes). Price under the gate: $35 dry / $45 full hookups Sun–Thu, $55 Fri–Sat; no gateway check needed. Not long-stay in character (weekly rates only, no monthly/seasonal language); no age restriction found; RV sites sold by the night. Good Sam false stays (not a Good Sam Park).

MIN STAY: ResNexus labelled a Saturday-arrival quote 'ENJOY FOR 2 NIGHTS OR MORE' and showed one RV site at $55 for one night as 'CALL US'; this may be a 2-night weekend minimum but is not stated as a rule anywhere, so min_stay was not written.

RATE CONFLICT: ResNexus's RV-site blurb still says '$35/$45 per night' for full hook-ups; the homepage (modified 2026-11-18) says $45 Sun–Thu / $55 Fri–Sat and ResNexus quoted $50/night (Sat+Sun average) — homepage figures used.

NOTE CORRECTED: the stored note's '400 Tecopa Hot Springs Rd', '~30 sites with 30/50-amp partial hookups plus 200+ dry sites' match the county campground (11828) next door, not this resort (860 Tecopa Hot Springs Rd, 30 A full hookups). No --AWH text involved.
